source.snippet: In the Field Service mobile app (iOS), the Schedule tab appointment card shows the date month-first ('Tuesday, Aug 25, 2026') instead of UK day-first ('25 Aug 2026'). The times on the same card are fine (24-hour), so it's just the date ordering. Org Default Locale, the mobile user's Locale, and the device Region are all English (United Kingdom). There's no date-format option in Field Service Mobile Settings.

problem_statement: Salesforce Field Service mobile app ignores locale settings and displays US date format to non-US field workers, causing scheduling confusion and compliance friction for enterprise customers outside North America.
target_segment: Field service operations managers and Salesforce admins at UK and European enterprises using Salesforce Field Service
notes: Buyer signal: enterprise Salesforce Field Service customers pay significant licensing fees; localization bugs create compliance and operational risk. Opportunity: Salesforce consulting/admin service specializing in locale configuration and FSL mobile fixes, or a managed component overlay. Weak individual signal but points to recurring enterprise localization pain in Salesforce ecosystem.
